name: cloudflare
description: Focused shared Cloudflare MCP and CLI. Every mutation requires explicit confirmation.
long_description: Focused current Cloudflare REST management with 29 shared MCP tools/CLI commands, 18 reads and 11 explicitly confirmed mutations. Includes local schemas/previews, bounded pages, query-only analytics and a reviewed DNS batch digest. Official cf and Code Mode cover a much broader API. No automatic request retries; account outcomes and desktop GUI installation are separate checks.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute regular owner-only token file, at most 64 KB. Never bundle it.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and refuse all 11 mutations, including reviewed batch submission.

api_key.title: Cloudflare API token
api_key.description: Least-privilege Cloudflare Bearer API token; stored privately by the desktop client.

allow_operations.title: Allow explicitly confirmed account operations
allow_operations.description: Allow only explicitly confirmed mutations; read-only still takes precedence.

account_id.title: Default account ID
account_id.description: Optional Cloudflare account ID for account-scoped requests and account-token verification.

zone_id.title: Default zone ID
zone_id.description: Optional Cloudflare zone ID. This is a routing default, not a token permission boundary.

token_kind.title: Token kind
token_kind.description: Use user for a user API token or account for an account-owned token; affects doctor --network only.
